channel.title: Penta AI Guides
channel.description: Practical guides to website fonts, colors, CSS and design systems.

item.title: How to Extract a Design System from an Existing Website

item.description: Turn inconsistent margins, padding and gaps into a small CSS spacing scale. Audit component roles, handle exceptions and validate narrow layouts.

item.description: Read CSS shadow layers, offsets, blur and spread. Rebuild subtle card elevation, identify clipping, and test the result on the intended background.

item.title: Build a Consistent Border Radius System in CSS
item.description: Choose useful radius tokens for buttons, cards and nested surfaces. Inspect real corners, avoid clipping focus rings, and document intentional exceptions.

item.description: Hand off a website with clear tokens, assets, responsive rules and interaction states. Use acceptance criteria that can be checked in the running interface.

item.description: Build reusable cards that adapt to their container instead of the viewport. Set up containment, choose a useful breakpoint and debug queries that do not apply.

item.description: Debug sticky headers and sidebars by checking offsets, scrolling ancestors, available height and stacking. Fix the constraint instead of switching blindly to fixed.

item.description: Choose readable line spacing and understand unitless inheritance. Compare number and length values, inspect nested text, and test user spacing overrides.

item.description: Use row subgrid to align card sections across a collection without fixed text heights. Build a fallback and test long titles, missing content and narrow layouts.

item.description: Use tabular-nums for stable number columns and counters. Check font support, decimal formatting and alignment without changing the rest of your typography.

item.description: Diagnose synthetic bold or italic text. Inspect the loaded faces and font declarations before deciding whether to disable synthesis for a type specimen.

item.title: Evaluate content-visibility for Long Page Sections

item.title: Contain a Blend Effect with CSS isolation

item.title: Use picture for Different Mobile and Desktop Image Crops

item.title: Check Keyboard Order After Reordering a CSS Layout

item.title: Group Radio Choices with fieldset and legend
item.description: Give related radio controls a shared question with fieldset and legend. Keep individual labels, unique IDs and native grouping behavior clear.

item.title: Use autocomplete Tokens for Clear Address Forms

item.title: Why a 100% Width Input Overflows: Check box-sizing

item.title: overflow: hidden vs clip: Choose the Right Boundary
item.description: Compare clipping with hidden scrolling. Check focus, programmatic scrolling and formatting contexts before swapping overflow values on a component.

item.title: Why CSS Transforms Leave the Original Layout Space

item.title: Use Auto Margins to Split a Flex Navigation Row
item.description: Push one group of navigation actions to the far edge with an auto margin. Check free space, wrapping and reading direction without adding spacer elements.

item.title: Inspect a Wrapper Styled with display: contents

item.title: Build a Useful CSS Fallback with @supports
item.description: Use feature queries to layer a CSS enhancement onto a usable baseline. Test both paths and distinguish syntax support from a verified accessible interaction.

item.title: Style a Selected Option Card with CSS :has()
item.description: Let a labeled checkbox drive its card’s selected appearance with :has(). Keep native interaction, a usable fallback and a selector scoped to the component.

item.title: Register a Typed CSS Color Token with @property
item.description: Define a custom property’s color syntax, inheritance and initial value. Check registration failures and unsupported browsers before changing a shared token contract.

item.title: Fix a Decorative Overlay That Blocks Clicks
item.description: Inspect pointer hit testing when a visual overlay covers a control. Use pointer-events selectively and keep keyboard behavior and disabled semantics separate.

item.title: Fade a Background Without Fading Its Text
item.description: Compare element opacity with alpha colors on a note surface. Keep labels opaque, inspect the composited background and review hidden interaction states.

item.title: Use CSS Hyphenation with the Correct Content Language
item.description: Improve narrow text columns with hyphens and accurate lang attributes. Check dictionary availability, editorial exceptions and long identifiers separately.

item.title: Keep Fallback Text Legible with font-size-adjust

item.description: Set a flexible reading width with ch while understanding what the unit measures. Review real text, font changes and padding instead of assuming an exact character count.

item.title: Mark the Current Navigation Page with aria-current
item.description: Pair a visible active-link style with aria-current="page". Keep navigation semantics, route matching and keyboard focus separate from selected tab behavior.

item.title: meter vs progress: Represent a Value or a Task
item.description: Choose native meter or progress markup by meaning. Label the indicator, distinguish indeterminate work and keep visible values synchronized with actual state.

item.title: Give a Native Range Input a Clear Label and Value
item.description: Build a labeled range control with explicit bounds and a visible value. Review keyboard changes, step size and whether a slider is appropriate for precise entry.
